notes.title: Big Toystore Update
notes.content: [p][b]Dear Unheim Community,[/b][/p][p]The beta phase for our [b]Toy Store Update [/b]finally comes to an end! First and foremost, a big [b]THANK YOU [/b]to everyone who tried out the beta and provided us with valuable feedback! Starting today, the following features will be available on the main branch:[/p][list][*][p][b]Toy Store [/b]- a brand new level, haunted by its own unique entity: the [b]Sorrowling! [/b]Can you see through its deceitful mimicry and live to see another day?[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]Speed Dial [/b]now provides a bonus based on your reporting performance.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Tool: Chrono-Plasmatic Nullification Surge[/b] When your speed dial reaches full charge, unleash an EMP-style discharge that fixes all active anomalies and scares off any entities. [/p][/*][*][p][b]New Camera Enhancement: Alternating Tetraocular Surveillance Monitor[/b] Activate to view four camera feeds at once. Click any feed to focus on it and exit the enhancement. [/p][/*][*][p]Numerous [b]balance tweaks[/b] and [b]bug fixes[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Price increase[/b][/p][p]As mentioned in our beta announcement post, we decided to accompany this update with a price increase. While the original price point felt appropriate for the initial Early Access version of UNHEIM, we since had the opportunity to improve on a lot of aspects of the base game (mostly due to the super helpful feedback we received), while also adding new content. The new price tag aims to reflect the work that has gone into UNHEIM so far and will help us greatly on our remaining path down Early Access lane![/p][p][/p][p][b]What's next?[/b][/p][p]Our next big [b]Update [/b]will focus on our Twitch Integration and Streaming Features![/p][p]In the meantime, expect the odd bugfix and balancing update here and there :)[/p][p][/p][p]We hope you enjoy the new content! If you have feedback, as always, we are excited to hear about it in the discussions or our discord![/p]

[b]New Tool: Chrono-Plasmatic Nullification Surge[/b] When your speed dial reaches full charge, unleash an EMP-style discharge that fixes all active anomalies and scares off any entities.
[b]New Camera Enhancement: Alternating Tetraocular Surveillance Monitor[/b] Activate to view four camera feeds at once. Click any feed to focus on it and exit the enhancement.

notes.title: Unheim - Patch 0.10.31
notes.content:
[h3]Dear Unheim Community[/h3]

We released another update today, adressing the following topics:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where reconnecting to twitch was not possible after being disconnected due to network issues.
[*] When disconnecting from twitch during a running observation, the viewer ranking is preserved until the streamer reconnects or until the start of the next observation (whichever occurs first)
[*] Added keyboard shortcuts to journal, entity webscreen and Leo's bible. We will allow for rebinding the specific keys via the settings menu in a later update.
[*] Fixed a bug where the veiled woman would sometimes not flee after having been spotted by the player.
[/list]

As in the last patch, a few new anomalies found their way into the game as well! Can you find them before they can find you?

[b]Thanks for sticking with us, and stay tuned for more updates![/b]

notes.title: The big "We fixed the Spider" Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Our big Jan... well, February (almost March) Update is out![/h1]

Dear Unheimers, in our first big [b]update[/b] we present you a chaotic mix of gameplay improvements, quality of life changes and audiovisual overhauls! 

First and foremost, we completely reworked the [b]Hospital Entity[/b], which we (and many of you as well) felt was lacking in terms of gameplay mechanics and overall scariness. We are much happier with the new version, and hope you feel the same way!

Our other main focus was on [b]improving our anomalies[/b]. We removed some of the less interesting ones, as well as those that felt duplicated, while adding [b]scarier[/b] ones across all levels.
Additionally, we allowed some of the more ambiguous anomalies to have [b]more than one type[/b], so finding out the correct code for reporting becomes less of a guessing game. 

We also made some changes to our difficulty settings: 
We turned Sanctuary into an easier version of Nightmare mode, where the entity can now appear as well. For unlocking new levels, beating Sanctuary mode is sufficient. To compensate, we added a new mode called [b]Training[/b], which replaces the old Sanctuary mode, allowing you to focus on anomaly reporting without fearing any intervention from our malevolent entities.

Besides that, we added [b]balancing changes[/b], [b]bugfixes[/b] and [b]audiovisual improvements[/b] across the board. You can find the full list of changes below. 

As always we would love to hear about your feedback, either in the [b]steam discussions[/b] or on our [b]discord[/b]!

[b]Happy Anomaly Hunting![/b]


[h2]Full list of changes[/h2]

[b]Entities[/b]
[list]
[*]Completely reworked the Hospital Entity, now called "Gramweberin", to match the overall vibe of the game
[*]Items stolen by the Smiling Man now appear inside the level as anomalies of type "Personal" and can be retrieved by reporting them
[*]Smiling Man now is less forgiving when being ignored and will no longer make himself audibly known before killing the player
[*]Smiling Man now generally grants less time to react to his presence
[*]The panic button now has interactions with the entities from Level 1, 2 and 3.
[*]Adjusted Journal entries related to the new Hospital Entity, the Gramweberin.
[/list]
[b]Anomalies[/b]
[list]
[*]Reworked all missed-activity-polaroids to show missed activities more clearly
[*]Anomalies can now have multiple valid types, making it easier to deduce the code for reporting them
[*]Replaced some of the less interesting anomalies, and added new anomalies across all levels
[*]Removed special anomaly types from each level (except "Personal" as it's gameplay relevant)
[*]Fixed or replaced some incorrectly or confusingly categorized anomalies
[/list]
[b]Observer Screen[/b]
[list]
[*]Updated magnifier icon to better reflect its function
[*]The P.A.I.M. button (1st enhancement) on the observer screen no longer blinks when the overall Paranormal Activity in the level has increased.
[/list]
[b]Audio[/b]
[list]
[*]Replaced and polished Ambient sound for all levels
[*]Reworked entity related sound effects
[*]Adjusted audio volumes across the board
[/list]
[b]Localization[/b]
[list]
[*]Updated some descriptions and localizations
[*]Replaced handwriting font for Simplified Chinese for better readability 
[/list]
[b]Balancing[/b]
[list]
[*]Turned Sanctuary into an easier version of Nightmare mode, where the entity can now appear as well. To compensate, we added a new mode called "Training", which replaces the old sanctuary mode.
[*]New levels can now be unlocked by beating the current level in "Sanctuary" difficulty or above.
[*]All screens inside the van now need to go through a short boot sequence when turning on the power. 
[*]Shortened each bible passage to just a single number to make finding the corresponding audio clip easier.
[*]Playing the wrong audio clip when the priest is around now is the best way to get yourself stabbed.
[*]Changed the arm waving behaviour of the Maneki Neko (waving cat)
[/list]
[b]Menu[/b]
[list]
[*]All settings can be reset to default now
[*]Added placeholder for Game-Won screen. Will be replaced again in our Story update later this year.
[/list]
[b]Tutorial[/b]
[list]
[*]Added additional explainers for newly unlocked gameplay elements.
[/list]
[b]Quality of Life[/b]
[list]
[*]In case of a power outage, the protagonist now does the reasonable thing and turns on their flashlight
[*]The journal has a new colour to stand out more from the background
[*]The Journal now has an indicator for unread entries
[*]Game Over/Game Won Screens can now be skipped
[*]Made it easier to click on the handles for the battery and the fuse box
[*]The Pizza is now edible
[/list]
[b]Twitch Integration[/b]
[list]
[*] The wildcard button now always fixes an anomaly if at least 1 correct vote has been cast by the viewers
[*] Voting chart is cleared completely after using the wildcard button.
[/list]
[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where the smiling man just wouldn't stop laughing
[*]Twitch: Cooldowns now correctly apply to subscriber- and bit events
[*]Prevented Fusebox sound from playing when loading the Van scene for the first time
[*]Fixed several visual bugs related to the "Death by too many anomalies" event in the museum level
[*]Potentially fixed a rare issue that would lead to freeze frames every few seconds.
[/list]
[b]Known Issues[/b]
[list]
[*]Overall performance is not quite where we would like it to be yet, and we're still working on optimizing the game across the board for a stutter-free experience
[*]Some Steam Achievements have no description and will either be removed, adjusted or are still being worked on during Early Access
[*]Steam sometimes doesn't recognize the game as being closed after shutting it down. This leads to the impression that the game is still running even though it's not. (We're not mining crypto in the background on your machine, we promise!)
[/list]

notes.title: Unheim: January Update - Call for Beta Testers
notes.content:
[h1]The Big January Update is in Beta![/h1]

We are bringing significant changes to [b]UNHEIM[/b]: The third level’s entity has been entirely reworked to better align with the game’s overall vibe, while key adjustments to the Smiling Man, level audio design, Anomaly types and balancing aim to deliver more fear with less frustration. By popular demand, we’ve also added a new Easy difficulty mode for a more relaxed but still spooky experience. Additionally, Streamers will find the improved Wildcard mechanic more rewarding and engaging. 

Now we really [b]need your input[/b]: Are the scares hitting the mark? Is the new balancing working across all difficulties? How does the new Spider compare to her former self? 
If you want to help improve [b]UNHEIM[/b], try the Beta Branch and share your feedback with us!

[b]To access the BETA, please follow these steps: [/b]
[olist]
[*] Open Steam
[*] Right-click on UNHEIM in your library
[*] Select Properties
[*] Go to the BETAS tab
[*] Enter the password: pepperonipizza
[*] Choose "community-beta" from the Beta participation drop-down list
[*] Wait for the game to update the files (if nothing happens, restart the Steam client)
[*] Launch the game
[/olist]

We would love to hear about your feedback, either in the [b]steam discussions[/b] or on our [b]discord[/b]!



Here is the full list of changes:

[b]Twitch Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Joker button now always fixes an anomaly if at least 1 correct vote has been cast by the viewers
[*] Voting chart is cleared completely after using the joker
[/list]
[b]Entities[/b]
[list]
[*] Completely reworked the Hospital Entity, now called "Gramweberin", to match the overall vibe of the game
[*] Items stolen by the Smiling Man now appear inside the level as anomalies of type "Personal" and can be retrieved by reporting them
[*] Smiling Man now is less forgiving when being ignored and will no longer make himself audibly known before killing the player
[*] Smiling Man now generally grants less time to react to his presence
[/list]
[b]Anomalies[/b]
[list]
[*] Reworked all snapshots to show missed activities more clearly
[*] Anomalies can now have multiple valid types, making it easier to deduce the code for reporting them
[*] Replaced some of the less interesting anomalies, and added new anomalies across all levels
[*] Removed special anomaly types from each level (except "Personal" as it's gameplay relevant)
[*] Fixed or replaced some incorrectly or confusingly categorized anomalies
[/list]
[b]Van[/b]
[list]
[*] The journal has a new colour to stand out more from the background
[*] Journal now has an indicator for unread entries
[*] Adjusted Journal entries to for the new Gramweberin
[*] Changed the arm waving behaviour of the Maneki Neko (waving cat)
[*] Updated magnifier icon to better reflect its function
[/list]
[b]Audio[/b]
[list]
[*] Replaced and polished Ambient sound for all levels
[*] Reworked entity related sound effects
[*] Adjusted audio volumes across the board
[/list]
[b]Localization[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated some descriptions and localizations
[*] Replaced handwriting font for Simplified Chinese for better readability 
[/list]
[b]Balancing[/b]
[list]
[*] Turned Sanctuary into an easier version of Nightmare mode, where the entity can now appear as well. 
[*] To compensate, we added a new mode called "Training", which replaces the old sanctuary mode.
[*] New levels can now be unlocked by beating the current level in "Sanctuary" difficulty or above.
[*] All screens inside the van now need to go through a short boot sequence when turning on the power. 
[*] Shortened each bible passage to just a single number to make finding the corresponding audio clip easier.
[*] Playing the wrong audio clip when the priest is around now is the best way to get yourself stabbed.
[/list]
[b]Menu[/b]
[list]
[*] All settings can be reset to default now
[/list]
[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the smiling man just wouldn't stop laughing
[*] Twitch: Cooldowns now correctly apply to subscriber- and bit events
[/list]
[b]Known Issues[/b]
[list]
[*] When the Smiling Man steals the Lava Lamp, it doesn't always appear inside the level
[*] Description on the Hospital Level Polaroid still mentions drowsiness, even though the mechanic has been removed
[*] A small amount of users reported encountering freeze frames every few seconds. We're still investigating this issue.
[*] Overall performance is not quite where we would like it to be yet, and we're still working on optimizing the game across the board for a stutter-free experience
[*] Some Steam Achievements have no description and will either be removed, adjusted or are still being worked on during Early Access
[*] Steam sometimes doesn't recognize the game as being closed after shutting it down. This leads to the impression that the game is still running even though it's not. 
  (We're not mining crypto in the background on your machine, we promise!)
[*] The leaderboard is haunted! Sometimes, your playtime appears in the leaderboard even though you have been playing another difficulty than endless mode
[/list]

notes.title: Unheim - Balancing Patch 0.9.17
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Unheim Heads![/h1]

We are super thankful for the positive reception of our game over the last week. Of course, we have also been listening closely to the very valid points of criticism we received. Based on your suggestions, we will focus on removing obstacles that only distract from the scares. Additionally, we plan to improve accessibility, and tweak areas of confusion to further enhance your gameplay and horror experience.

As these updates require a longer development cycle and will therefore be part of our first major balancing update at a later date, we want to address the most urgent issues today in this small balancing patch: 

[list]
[*] Since we got the impression that the hospital entity, "die Traumweberin", is too challenging for the wrong reasons, we decided to make banishing it a lot simpler in this update. For our next big update, we will redesign it to fit better in with the rest of the game.
[*] Charging the battery now happens a lot faster, so you can spend more time observing and less time torturing your wrist!
[/list]

We hope you enjoy the new changes, and wish you a happy holiday!

* Charging the battery now happens a lot faster, so you can spend more time observing and less time torturing your wrist!

notes.title: Unheim - Patch 0.9.16
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Unheim Community[/h1]

With this patch, we provide much needed updates for our endless mode, which was rightfully perceived as way too easy, especially coming from inferno difficulty. We also fixed a bug that prevented the correct observation time from being send to the steam leaderboards. For this update, we had to wipe all currently existing entries from the leaderboards. We are super sorry about that, especially to anyone who already commited to this mode. We hope that you will give it another spin anyways and enjoy the new difficulty!
Please find the full changelog below:

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug in Endless mode statistics which caused incorrect playtimes to be recorded and displayed on the Steam leaderboard.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused spanish texts to sometimes pick the wrong translation and font.
[*] Fixed an incorrectly tagged flickering Chandelier in the cathedral from "Object removed" anomaly to "Light" anomaly
[/list]

[b]Balancing[/b]
[list]
[*] Endless mode now starts out more difficult and has a steeper difficulty-over-time curve.
[*] "Die Traumweberin" is now easier to track, due to slightly reduced movement speed and less variation in move direction.
[*] "Die Traumweberin" appears less often during an observation
[*] Made it slightly easier to spot plagues in the cathedral early
[*] The "Paranormal Disturbance Visualizer" now takes time to calibrate to make it less powerful
[/list]

We hope you enjoy the new updates! As always, happy hunting!

notes.title: Early Access Release
notes.content:
[h1]UNHEIM is available for Early Access![/h1]

Charge up your batteries and get ready to dial, because [b]UNHEIM[/b] is finally available for [b]Early Access[/b] on Windows!
From now on, you can test your observational prowess in [b]4 distinct levels[/b], each haunted by their own [b]unique Paranormal Entity[/b]. At your disposal are a variety of [b]Gadgets[/b], helping you to stay one step ahead of the dreaded game over screen. 
After conquering the terrors of the game, start conquering the [b]Steam Leaderboards[/b] in [b]Endless mode[/b]. It's gonna be a long night!
Of course, Early Access marks only the beginning. We have a lot more planned for the future, and hope that you will accompany us on our journey to version 1.0! 

Last but not least, a huge [b]THANK YOU[/b] to all the players of our demo, who helped shaping this release by providing invaluable feedback and provided relentless support. 

We can’t wait to hear your screams as you dive into the Early Access of [b]UNHEIM[/b].

❤️ Your Lovely Bytes Team ❤️
[i]
P.S.: To anybody who was hoping for a Linux version and Gamepad support - sorry to keep you waiting just a little bit longer. These features are still in testing, and will be available as soon as we can guarantee a smooth gameplay experience for both![/i]

notes.content:
First off, a massive[b] THANK YOU [/b]to everyone who’s played the [b]UNHEIM [/b]demo and shared your thoughts with us. Your feedback has been our guiding light, and we’ve been hard at work bringing your ideas to life and squashing every bug that crawled out of the shadows! 

As a result, we’re beyond excited to unveil [b]a huge update[/b] just in time for the upcoming [b]Scream Fest[/b], packed with [b]new features[/b] and[b] major gameplay improvements[/b]:

More meaningful [b]Battery [/b]& additional[b] Fuse Box[/b] mechanics

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44839853/5472ca5fe82f7e5d8d13fe535f94fc4035b4cbbc.gif[/img]

...and even more:
[list]
[*] Extended Live Streaming Interactions – now with event triggers linked to [b]Channel Points[/b] 
[*] Finally [b]Controller [/b]Support!
[*] Level [b]Balancing [/b]– we've fine-tuned the first level to be slightly more forgiving without sacrificing the fear factor.

[/list]


We couldn’t have done it without your input, and we’re thrilled to see how these changes shape your experience!  
Also, if you haven’t already, join our official [url=https://discord.gg/nsZ6hKD5RP]Discord [/url]to connect with the devs and actively influence the development of [b]UNHEIM [/b]with your ideas. 
Thank you for being a part of the [b]UNHEIM [/b]community and for your relentless support. We can’t wait to hear your screams as you dive into the new and improved horrors. 

Happy Scream Fest!  
Your Lovely Bytes Team

notes.title: Unheim Demo is online!
notes.content:
We're happy to announce that the Demo for Unheim, our paranormal surveillance game with a twist, is finally available here on Steam! 

In the demo you start right at the beginning of the main game. You can explore your van, story snippets, and clear the first level of paranormal activities and entities in a variety of game modes:

[list]
[*] [b]Sanctuary:[/b] A more laid back experience, where you can focus on the spot-the-difference aspect of our game. Think of it as a practice mode.

[*] [b]Nightmare:[/b] The real deal, where your nightly observation routine is disturbed by the looming presence of a murderous entity

[*] [b]Inferno:[/b] Unlocked by beating nightmare difficulty, this mode considerably cranks up the difficulty and has a few additional surprises in store!
[/list]

If you happen to be a streamer, you can also make full use of the game's twitch integration, allowing your viewers to aid you in your investigations. 
If you don't stream, the game is still perfectly playable, using the twitch integration is entirely optional :)

We hope you have a great time with the demo, and would love to hear from you in our discord!
We're always eager to improve the experience of our game, so feel free to make suggestions and share your feedback with us.

Finally, a huge thank you to our existing community for their continued support and valuable feedback,
without which we wouldn't have made it to this point! 


[b]What's next for the demo?[/b]

We're currently working on adding controller support,
as well as providing Steam Deck and Linux versions of our game.
We will also continue to update the demo with bugfixes and balancing changes,
as well as with feedback from our community.
Also, we plan to add support for bits and channel point events to our twitch integration, as well as the ability to upload custom sounds and images, so be sure to check in regularly for updates!


[b]I got the demo for free, why should I care for the full game?[/b]

The complete game will feature additional levels, each haunted by their own unique entity.

Each level, including the one from the demo, will also sport an endless mode, complete with steam leaderboard integration. So if you were looking for an excuse to stay up all night, there you have it!

Additional surveillance tools to augment your nightly watch.

Lastly, expect something vaguely like this:

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44839853/8b7f9ed7724c0574e4eeeaafd2e3a4f7970bc606.gif[/img]
